body:
## Publication posture

Public developmental/research specification.

## Parent

Parent: #9.

## Objective

Define the **minimum mathematics worth front-loading between formal logic and Rosetta epistemic semantics**.

Do not reproduce an arbitrary school curriculum. Admit mathematics because it provides reusable machinery for representing relationships, transformations, quantity, structure, uncertainty or composition.

## Initial scope

The first mathematical tranche SHOULD include only the portions needed by downstream Rosetta/New Ithkuil semantics, approximately:

- natural/integer/rational number identity and basic arithmetic;
- equality/inequality and ordering;
- variables, expressions and substitution;
- elementary algebraic transformation;
- sets, membership, subset, union/intersection/difference/complement;
- relations and relation properties;
- functions, mappings, inverse/composition where defined;
- tuples/products and finite Cartesian structure;
- finite combinatorics/counting sufficient for generated logic worlds;
- directed/undirected graphs, nodes, edges, paths, neighborhoods;
- elementary probability / conditional probability only to the extent required by uncertainty and later belief-revision work;
- vectors/matrices only when they are needed to describe geometry or later learner interfaces, not as ceremonial pretraining.

Geometry, trigonometry, calculus and deeper mathematics are deferred unless a concrete downstream dependency earns them.

## Machine-native requirement

All training/evaluation tasks in this tranche MUST be representable without natural-language semantics.

Examples may use symbolic/pasigraphic identities, structured finite worlds and deterministic evaluators.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every admitted mathematical primitive has a declared downstream use.
- [ ] No topic is included merely because it appears in a conventional high-school syllabus.
- [ ] Sets/relations/functions/graphs provide sufficient machinery for COGAL-06 Rosetta compositions.
- [ ] Finite deterministic evaluators exist for the admitted scope.
- [ ] Held-out compositions test generalization beyond memorized examples.
- [ ] Deferred math topics remain explicitly available for later tranches without blocking language admission.
- [ ] Output is consumable by COGAL-06/#17/#62.

## Dependencies

COGAL-02 (#80).

## Downstream

COGAL-06, COGAL-08, #82.

## Workability

`EXECUTABLE_LEAF`: one bounded mathematical-substrate specification.
title: COGAL-07: Define the minimal mathematical relational substrate for pre-language Bilqis training
